records.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Nadia,

Thanks for reaching out. Honestly been heads-down elsewhere, haven't had much time to dig in yet.

Victor

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Wanted to check in on Timber Collective's setup. If you haven't gotten to inviting the rest of the team yet, no rush -- just let me know if anything's in the way.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Victor says he's been heads-down and hasn't dug in (email:aabdb002) despite three nudges (2e9390ad, 26b3ca25, 4132ca74). A getting-started call was held 7/24 (calendar:80c4321a) yet no project by 7/27. Pro plan, 8 days left give some chance, but no invite, no project, no tickets signal low engagement.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for the honest reply -- heads-down elsewhere is completely fair, and good to talk on Thursday's call.

When you do get a window, the quickest first step is a single project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you on a 15-minute call this week -- just name a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Nadia
